record.paper_title: A Survey on Physics Informed Reinforcement Learning: Review and Open Problems
record.original_question: How can physics-informed reinforcement learning provide model-agnostic safe exploration and control for reinforcement-learning agents operating in complex and uncertain environments? The question asks for methods that do not depend on a specific approximated system model or a pre-specified safe-state set, while still enabling the agent to respect safety constraints during exploration and learned-policy deployment.

evidence.quote: Safe reinforcement learning involves learning control policies that guarantee system performance and respect safety constraints during both exploration and policy deployment.

But these approaches are limited by the approximated model of the system and the prior knowledge about safe state sets. There has been a lot of research for better system identification or model learning through physics incorporation. But most works do not generalize well to different tasks and environments. To summarize, future works should address these crucial research goals: 1) model agnostic safe exploration and control using RL agents in complex and uncertain environments and 2) devise generalized approach of incorporating physics in data-driven Model learning.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is presented as an open research direction in surveys of physics-informed reinforcement learning. Recent works (e.g., "Progressive Safeguards for Safe and Model-Agnostic Reinforcement Learning," 2024, and physics-augmented safe RL papers from 2025–2026) propose partial approaches, but no method to date provides model-agnostic safe exploration and control with provable guarantees that generalize across tasks without relying on approximated system models or pre-specified safe-state sets. The problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: A survey on physics informed reinforcement learning: Review and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Highlights gaps and unresolved issues in physics-informed RL, including safe exploration.
status_evidence.claim: Model-agnostic safe exploration is listed as an open research goal.

status_evidence.title: Progressive Safeguards for Safe and Model-Agnostic Reinforcement Learning
status_evidence.snippet: Proposes a finite-state safeguard approach offering a model-agnostic safe learning method.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress exists on model-agnostic safe RL via safeguard mechanisms.

status_evidence.title: A Review of Safe Reinforcement Learning Methods for Modern Power Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys safe RL methods and notes outstanding challenges around constraint satisfaction under uncertainty.
status_evidence.claim: Safe RL under uncertain dynamics without explicit safe sets remains challenging.
